title: Returning something to a shop
es: Pedir un cambio o reembolso con educación y firmeza
goal: Explicar un problema con un producto y negociar una solución.
phrases: Could I get a refund instead?
That's not what I was expecting.
Eso no es lo que esperaba.

turns.t: Good afternoon. How can I help you today?

y.say: Hi, I bought these headphones last week, but the left side doesn't work properly. I'd like to return them.
y.es: Hola, compré estos auriculares la semana pasada pero el lado izquierdo no funciona bien. Quisiera devolverlos.
alts: I got these headphones last week and the left one is not working well. I want to return them.

turns.t: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt with you? And may I ask, have you tried them with a different phone? Sometimes it's just a connection problem.
turns.es: Lamento oírlo. ¿Tiene el recibo? ¿Los ha probado con otro teléfono? A veces es solo un problema de conexión.

y.say: Yes, here's the receipt. I tried them with two different phones and the problem is the same.
y.es: Sí, aquí está el recibo. Los probé con dos teléfonos y el problema es el mismo.
alts: Here is the receipt. I tested them on two phones and it is the same problem.

turns.t: Thank you. Everything looks fine with the receipt. Unfortunately, we don't have the same model in stock at the moment, but I can offer you a similar pair from another brand, or store credit for the full amount.
turns.es: Gracias. El recibo está bien. Lamentablemente no tenemos el mismo modelo en stock, pero puedo ofrecerle otro par de otra marca o crédito en tienda por el total.

c.q: What two options does the shop offer?
o: A similar pair or store credit
A refund or a gift card

y.say: I'd prefer a refund to my card, if that's possible. I'm not sure I want another brand.
y.es: Preferiría un reembolso a mi tarjeta, si es posible. No estoy seguro de querer otra marca.
alts: Could I get my money back on my card please? I don't really want a different brand.

turns.t: Let me check with my manager. Well, normally we only give store credit after seven days, but since the product is faulty, I think we can make an exception. It'll take three to five working days to appear in your account.
turns.es: Déjeme consultar con mi gerente. Normalmente solo damos crédito pasados siete días, pero como el producto es defectuoso, podemos hacer una excepción. Tardará de tres a cinco días hábiles.

y.say: That's great, thank you for your help. Just to be sure, it will take three to five working days, right?
y.es: Genial, gracias por su ayuda. Solo para confirmar, tardará de tres a cinco días hábiles, ¿verdad?
alts: Thanks for helping me. So it takes three to five working days, correct?

turns.t: That's right. You'll get a confirmation email today. Is there anything else I can help you with?
turns.es: Correcto. Recibirá un correo de confirmación hoy. ¿Algo más en lo que pueda ayudarle?

y.say: No, that's everything. Thanks again and have a good afternoon.
y.es: No, eso es todo. Gracias de nuevo y buena tarde.
alts: No, nothing else. Thank you very much, have a nice afternoon.
